% 791-write-immediate-file-stream5: verifies an \immediate\write to file stream 5 lands in the generated file and reads back.
\input prelude
\immediate\openout5=ls791data.txt
\immediate\write5{alpha 791}
\immediate\closeout5
\openin1=ls791data.txt
\read1 to \gotA
\message{791 back=\meaning\gotA}
\read1 to \gotB
\ifeof1\message{791 eof-yes}\else\message{791 eof-no}\fi
\closein1
\setbox0=\hbox{\vrule width91pt height8pt depth2pt}
\lsshipbox0
\end
